title: Plan a winter walk
intro: Set a start and destination inside the coverage area, then compare routes.

points.picking: Click the map to set the {{point}}

manual.invalid: Enter a latitude between −90 and 90 and a longitude between −180 and 180.
manual.outsideHint: This point is outside the coverage area; routing will be refused.

search.label: Search an address
search.disabled: Address search is off: no permitted geocoding provider is configured for this deployment. Pick a point on the map or enter coordinates instead.

geo.consentBody: Your browser will ask for permission. Your location is used once to set the start point, kept only in this page, and never stored or logged by WinterPath.
geo.denied: Location permission was denied. You can still pick a point on the map or enter coordinates.
geo.unavailable: Your location isn't available right now. Pick a point on the map or enter coordinates.
geo.unsupported: This browser doesn't support location. Pick a point on the map or enter coordinates.

desc.step_free: Only uses paths verified as step-free. Anything unverified is excluded, so a route may not exist.
desc.reduced_mobility: Slower walking speed for time estimates.

avoidReports.label: Avoid unverified reports when possible
avoidReports.desc: Penalises paths with 311 or community reports. They are reports, not confirmed obstacles.

needPoints: Set both a start and a destination.

results.title: Route comparison
results.unknownShareDesc: {{pct}} of this route has unknown conditions — unknown is not zero risk.
results.identical: Both routes are the same: no better winter-aware alternative was found.

NO_ROUTE.title: No route found
NO_ROUTE.body: There's no legal pedestrian path with these settings. With the step-free profile, any path not verified as step-free is excluded. Try the standard profile or different points.

OUTSIDE_COVERAGE.title: Outside the coverage area
OUTSIDE_COVERAGE.body: Both points must be inside the coverage area (hatched outside). Move your start or destination inside it.

RATE_LIMITED.title: Too many requests
RATE_LIMITED.body: Please wait a moment before comparing again.

generic.title: Couldn't compute routes
generic.body: The routing service didn't respond as expected.

OFF_NETWORK.title: Too far from the walking network
OFF_NETWORK.body: Your {{point}} is inside the coverage area but more than {{max}} m from any mapped walkway, so it can't be connected to a route. Move it closer to a sidewalk or path.
OFF_NETWORK.nearest: Nearest mapped walkway: about {{nearest}} m away.

WAKE_TIMEOUT.title: The server is still asleep
WAKE_TIMEOUT.body: The routing server didn't wake up within about 90 seconds. It's on a free plan that sleeps when idle. No routes are shown. Try again in a moment.

unreachable.title: Couldn't reach the routing server
unreachable.body: The request failed before the server answered. Check your connection and try again. No routes are shown.

UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE.title: A data source is unavailable
UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE.body: The server is up, but a data source it needs didn't respond. No routes are shown rather than routes built on missing data.

INCOMPLETE.title: Incomplete answer
INCOMPLETE.body: The server's answer was missing parts of the result, so nothing is shown rather than a partial comparison.

overlays.title: Map layers
overlays.zoomIn: Zoom in to load map layers.
overlays.outsidePilot: This view is outside the coverage area.
overlays.none: No closures or reports in this view.
overlays.demoNote: Closures & reports are simulated. Sidewalk lines are real OpenStreetMap data (pilot_mini fixture, a few blocks around McGill) with unknown conditions — no risk layer is active.

hazardSources.overlay: Closures and 311 reports may be missing from this map: not every source is loaded in this deployment. An empty list does not mean there are none.
hazardSources.route: These routes could not take closures or 311 reports into account: not every source is loaded in this deployment. A route may cross a closure that isn't shown. Check conditions on site.
hazardSources.unchecked: We couldn't check which closure and report sources are loaded.

map.label: Route planning map
map.fallback: The interactive map can't be shown in this browser (WebGL unavailable). You can still enter coordinates and read the route as a list.
map.loadError: The basemap couldn't load. You can still enter coordinates and read the route as a list.
map.hint: Map is optional: every action is also available in the panel.

sheet.toggle: Planner panel: {{state}}. Tap to resize, or use the arrow keys.
sheet.empty: Plan a walk: choose a start and a destination

cards.label: Route summaries
cards.unknown: No condition data for {{pct}} of the route
cards.known: Condition data along the whole route

recent.optIn: Remember recent destinations on this device
recent.desc: Off by default. Up to 5 destinations (never your start point), rounded to about 11 m and kept only in this browser for 30 days. Unticking deletes them.
recent.title: Recent destinations
